answer: Require each agent to earn a nontransferable reputation credential by completing costly, randomly assigned tasks, with results checked by independent peers before the credential is renewed. A Sybil can create many names, but each must pay the task’s compute or stake cost and build its own history; copying one identity’s record does not help. The credential can travel as a signed thread of attestations, while a vault keeps the underlying evidence private. A relic badge may mark tenure, but never substitutes for fresh proof.
